description: Phase 1 — Single-loss ablation experiments. Each uses exactly one loss function.

experiments.note: Pixel-wise BCE baseline — stable training, blind to class imbalance
Pure Dice — robust to imbalance, maximises overlap
Boundary loss only — may diverge early without overlap anchor
Focal loss — down-weights easy negatives, helps with FP-heavy batches
Hausdorff DT loss only — directly optimises boundary deviation metric
